result.title: AI Agents Explained
result.description:
If your AI just talks to you, you're only using 10% of what's possible 💀⁠
⁠
A chatbot can help you plan your day. An AI agent checks your calendar, drafts the email, sends it, AND follows up when nobody replies, all on its own.⁠
⁠
That's the difference: chatbots chat. Agents ACT.⁠
⁠
Since 2025, "agentic" has been THE word in AI, and the people learning to build and work with agents now are the ones capturing the real opportunities.⁠
⁠
Save this 🔖 and send it to your friend who thinks AI = ChatGPT
⁠

result.title: Tokens Explained
result.description:
Your AI isn't getting dumber mid-conversation. It's running out of tokens 💀⁠
⁠
Tokens are the currency of AI. Every model reads and writes in chunks (~¾ of a word). "Unbelievable" is actually THREE tokens: un + believ + able.⁠
⁠
Every AI cost, speed limit, and "context window" you've ever hit? That's a token limit in disguise.⁠
⁠
So next time ChatGPT suddenly feels worse halfway through a convo, now you know why.⁠
⁠
Send this to someone who rage-quits their AI chats.
